limits: Pause reserves remain unavailable to other campaigns. New Pause is accepted only during a running period; repeated accepted Pause is idempotent even beyond the old end.

Resume extends end by elapsed paused time while preserving starts_at, ledger, per-period credit limit, impression/cap counters and pacing inputs; legacy already-settled rows retain the explicit old new-period funding path.

Automatic cap is attributed at first processing claim in America/Chicago and includes processing plus paid. Legacy unresolved processing receives a conservative migration-month reservation because its actual claim time is unknown; historical paid uses recorded purchase ledger time when available.

Atomic claim is the in-flight boundary: a claim committed before Pause may settle later exactly once. Pause committed first prevents a new claim when no other active demand exists. No late callback resumes a campaign.

Never-claimed no-demand automatic intent may be superseded by explicit manual purchase. Explicit owner pack change may supersede its own never-claimed automatic intent; processing/manual/unknown evidence is protected.

Provider outcome unknown: retain processing, immutable payload/key and cap reservation. Known reference uses GET-only; unknown requests stop before provider key-retention expiry. Confirmed canceled permits terminal recovery without toggling owner preference; subsequent scheduled purchase still requires demand/cap.

Historical migration-specific tests remain historical regression checks. New cumulative SQL tests and final real PostgreSQL races validate the new lifecycle, while browser/provider fixtures have no real financial effects.

The source candidate inherits R4 but is a Campaign-only handoff, not the final integration or a release. Unchanged Windows/iOS suites were not repeated by this task after parent split integration ownership.

rollback.localBeforeDatabaseApply: After matching base/current hashes and ownership, apply lifecycle-product-inverse.patch to undo only the15Campaign product/test paths and retain immutable journals. The snapshot inverse is proof-only. Never reset/stash/clean or overwrite R4/other QA worktrees.
rollback.databaseAfterApply: Do not remove migrations1000/1100 or restore old expiry/worker logic after new state exists. Keep paused-reserve trigger ordering, demand checks, processing-month metadata, immutable claim payload/key and exactly-once ledger. Use tested forward correction; Git inverse is not a database rollback.
rollback.workerCompatibility: Old R4 worker can ignore provider_reference and misclassify unknown outcomes; do not run it against new processing orders. Keep the new worker/DB guards or hold dispatch and reconcile every in-flight order before a separately tested compatibility fallback. No automatic rollback executed.
rollback.iosWindows: No native bundle/Swift/host/config changes in this delta. Existing coordinators must validate combined code/native fallback against actually uploaded/installed source.
